summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on July 13. Shareholders elected Class II directors, approved the 2026 Employee Share Incentive Plan, and approved a share capital reduction and reorganization reducing par value from US$0.0001 to US$0.0000001 per share via a solvency statement route. This is a routine item under SEC Rule 13a-16 for foreign private issuers. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or activism is present; it is a standard governance update with no deal terms.
